REJECTED: `rev` (util-linux collision — blocks every Linux install), `re` (overloaded), `rv` (npm taken + active Homebrew Ruby version manager). `rvr` is Homebrew-clean; bare npm name taken by an abandoned FAA aviation tool, sidestepped via scoped @seabear/reverie with bin "rvr" (standard gh/pnpm pattern). FALLBACK if rvr becomes contested: `revr`.

NPM IS NOT AN INSTALL CHANNEL (decided 2026-06-09, see [[project.distributionChannels]]): the scoped @seabear/reverie name is a SQUATTING RESERVATION only — never published. package.json has private:true to block accidental publish. Install paths are GitHub binaries + Homebrew, period. The earlier 'npm is the tertiary install path' / 'npx @seabear/reverie works' framing is OBSOLETE — npx is impossible without publishing (#50 closed wontfix).
